name: olist-nl2sql-gold-v1

dataset.name: Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist
dataset.copy_used: GitHub mirror spdrio/Brazilian-E-Commerce-Public-Dataset-by-Olist (files/ folder); Kaggle was not reachable
dataset.caveat: This copy's reviews table has 100,000 rows; a published figure for Kaggle's current file is 99,224. Questions flagged depends_on_reviews_file_version may differ on another copy: re-run gold_sql on your own files.

definitions.timestamps: stored as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' text; date ranges use >= start and < next-day

comparison_hint: Compare result sets, not SQL text: ignore column aliases and row order unless order_sensitive; allow ~0.01 on money values and ~0.001 on ratios.

queries.question: What are the top 10 product categories by revenue (sum of item price)? Use English category names.
queries.gold_sql:
select t.product_category_name_english as category, round(sum(i.price), 2) as revenue
from order_items i
join products p on p.product_id = i.product_id
join product_category_name_translation t on t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
group by t.product_category_name_english order by revenue desc limit 10;
queries.gold_sql_csv_table_names:
select t.product_category_name_english as category, round(sum(i.price), 2) as revenue
from olist_order_items_dataset i
join olist_products_dataset p on p.product_id = i.product_id
join product_category_name_translation t on t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
group by t.product_category_name_english order by revenue desc limit 10;

queries.question: What was the revenue (sum of item price) per month for orders placed in 2017, all statuses?
queries.gold_sql:
select strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) as month, round(sum(i.price), 2) as revenue
from orders o join order_items i on i.order_id = o.order_id
where o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' and o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
group by month order by month;
queries.gold_sql_csv_table_names:
select strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) as month, round(sum(i.price), 2) as revenue
from olist_orders_dataset o join olist_order_items_dataset i on i.order_id = o.order_id
where o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' and o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
group by month order by month;

queries.question: What is the average total amount paid per order (sum of payment_value) for orders that contain at least one 'health_beauty' item?
queries.gold_sql:
select round(avg(t.total), 2) from (
  select p.order_id, sum(p.payment_value) as total from order_payments p
  where p.order_id in (
    select i.order_id from order_items i
    join products pr on pr.product_id = i.product_id
    join product_category_name_translation tr on tr.product_category_name = pr.product_category_name
    where tr.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty')
  group by p.order_id) t;
queries.gold_sql_csv_table_names:
select round(avg(t.total), 2) from (
  select p.order_id, sum(p.payment_value) as total from olist_order_payments_dataset p
  where p.order_id in (
    select i.order_id from olist_order_items_dataset i
    join olist_products_dataset pr on pr.product_id = i.product_id
    join product_category_name_translation tr on tr.product_category_name = pr.product_category_name
    where tr.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty')
  group by p.order_id) t;

common_wrong_answers.mistake: joins payments through order_items, duplicating payment rows for multi-item orders (fan-out)

queries.question: Which month of 2017 had the largest revenue increase over the previous month, and by how much?
queries.gold_sql:
with m as (
  select strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) as month, sum(i.price) as revenue
  from orders o join order_items i on i.order_id = o.order_id
  where o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' and o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' group by 1),
d as (select month, revenue - lag(revenue) over (order by month) as increase from m)
select month, round(increase, 2) as increase from d order by increase desc limit 1;
queries.gold_sql_csv_table_names:
with m as (
  select strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) as month, sum(i.price) as revenue
  from olist_orders_dataset o join olist_order_items_dataset i on i.order_id = o.order_id
  where o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' and o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' group by 1),
d as (select month, revenue - lag(revenue) over (order by month) as increase from m)
select month, round(increase, 2) as increase from d order by increase desc limit 1;

queries.question: What percentage of total item revenue comes from the top 10 sellers?
queries.gold_sql:
with s as (select seller_id, sum(price) as rev from order_items group by seller_id)
select round(100.0 * (select sum(rev) from (select rev from s order by rev desc limit 10)) / (select sum(rev) from s), 2);
queries.gold_sql_csv_table_names:
with s as (select seller_id, sum(price) as rev from olist_order_items_dataset group by seller_id)
select round(100.0 * (select sum(rev) from (select rev from s order by rev desc limit 10)) / (select sum(rev) from s), 2);

columns: round(100.0 * (select sum(rev) from (select rev from s order by rev desc limit 10)) / (select sum(rev) from s), 2)

queries.question: Among customer states with at least 1,000 delivered orders (that have a delivery date), which 3 have the highest percentage of late deliveries?
queries.gold_sql:
select c.customer_state, count(*) as delivered_orders,
  round(100.0 * sum(case when o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 2) as late_pct
from orders o join customers c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
where o.order_status = 'delivered' and o.order_delivered_customer_date is not null
group by c.customer_state having count(*) >= 1000
order by late_pct desc limit 3;
queries.gold_sql_csv_table_names:
select c.customer_state, count(*) as delivered_orders,
  round(100.0 * sum(case when o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 2) as late_pct
from olist_orders_dataset o join olist_customers_dataset c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
where o.order_status = 'delivered' and o.order_delivered_customer_date is not null
group by c.customer_state having count(*) >= 1000
order by late_pct desc limit 3;

queries.question: For delivered orders with a delivery date, what is the average review score for late vs on-time deliveries?
queries.gold_sql:
select case when o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date then 'late' else 'on_time' end as delivery,
  round(avg(r.review_score), 3) as avg_score, count(*) as reviews
from orders o join order_reviews r on r.order_id = o.order_id
where o.order_status = 'delivered' and o.order_delivered_customer_date is not null
group by delivery order by delivery;
queries.gold_sql_csv_table_names:
select case when o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date then 'late' else 'on_time' end as delivery,
  round(avg(r.review_score), 3) as avg_score, count(*) as reviews
from olist_orders_dataset o join olist_order_reviews_dataset r on r.order_id = o.order_id
where o.order_status = 'delivered' and o.order_delivered_customer_date is not null
group by delivery order by delivery;
